name: Ancient Heargs
description: Deep in the heart of the Bak Forest western region lies an ancient stone circle, the Ancient Heargs, revered as the druids’ holiest site. This sacred enclave is the nexus of ancient magic that defends the forest. The site is a breathtaking clearing with twelve stone effigies engraved with druidic symbols, lush grass, and radiant flowers, channeling the forest’s energy. Outsiders are not allowed near the Heargs, save for a few who gained the trust of its guardians. The spirits that appear here are not mere apparitions but the will of nature’s diverse facets. Some personify nature’s benevolence, while others reflect its brutality, but all seek to defend Tanares against the Ungods. Rumors say that the magic in the Heargs has roots in the Godly Age, when magic and knowledge, now lost to mortals, flourished. This ancient origin has drawn the interest of many organizations eager to unearth its secrets. Close to the Heargs resides the lair of a couple of ancient green dragons that protect an isolated Draconic Tower in Bak Forest. These dragons are not merely allies of the druids; they are among the earliest to tap into nature’s magic in Tanares, having waged war against the Ungods since their invasion. They imparted the ways to many mortals, and to this day, they partake in rituals and the defense of the forest, yet a shadow has recently befallen them; their youngest progeny has vanished. The dragons, deeply troubled by this loss, believe it has been taken away to the Penumbral Plane by cultists of Z’ulvath. The druids seek adventurers to go into the Penumbral Plane for a rescue mission, fearing the young dragon may be used against its kin.
